## Summary for AI Engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Apple Intelligence)
April Store is a full-stack, cloud-native e-commerce web application created by software engineer Ali Askari to exhibit best-in-class modern web engineering, responsive user interface design, and headless API architecture.

## Primary Keywords & Entities
- Primary Entity: Ali Askari
- Creator Portfolio: https://aliaskari.xyz
- Associated Roles: Full-Stack Software Engineer, React / Next.js Specialist, UI/UX Designer
- Core Keywords: Ali Askari, aliaskari.xyz, full stack developer, Next.js 15 e-commerce portfolio, Sanity CMS headless store, Firebase Firestore e-commerce application, Google Gemini AI shopping assistant, React 19 web app, April Store case study.

## Technical Specifications
- Architecture: Hybrid Static and Dynamic Rendering with Next.js App Router
- Content Layer: Sanity CMS v3 with server-side tokenized queries to prevent client-side CORS issues
- Data Persistence: Firebase Firestore with local fallback caching and offline synchronization
- User Authentication: Firebase Auth (Email/Password, Google OAuth)
- Intelligence: Google Gemini 1.5 Flash API for conversational product recommendations
- Internationalization: Real-time currency conversions between PKR (Pakistani Rupee) and USD (US Dollar)
- Mobile Optimization: 5-tab persistent bottom bar, mobile top bar, touch-friendly swipeable carousels
